input.provenance: Composed by tools/generate_benchmark_page_input.py from the already-committed classic-v1-e2e-reading-order, classic-v1-e2e-unicode, and classic-v1-e2e-tall-crop inputs onto one white 1280x720 page. No new pixels, font binary, OpenCV code, upstream image, or model asset enters the repository; the composition is a pure function of files this repository already pins by hash, and the generator asserts that no two placements overlap and none leaves the page.

limitations: This is a resource-measurement input for gate G3, not a semantic oracle. It carries no expected text, no expected geometry, and no oracle capture, because a latency or memory measurement does not need one and recording a correctness expectation this fixture cannot justify would be worse than recording none.

The only expectation it does carry is decoder-level: the recorded digest of the decoded 1280x720 BGR buffer. That pins PNG decoding at a page-sized input; it says nothing about detection or recognition on this page.

The page is three composed synthetic renderings on a white background. It is not a photograph, a scan, or a document with real-world noise, skew, compression artifacts, or varied fonts, so a latency figure measured on it is a lower bound on realistic input, not a representative one.
The generator's PNG reader accepts only 8-bit non-interlaced truecolour, which is what the three source fixtures are; it raises rather than guessing on anything else.
